text: H1 supported. E0005 (pre-registered, local-full): model argmax = T[first][last] on 72/72 prompts covering all 36 cells with two different middle fillers. E0003 (exploratory): for (4,*,*,7) and (7,*,*,4) all 36 middles give the same output. Held-out: predict() agrees with the model on 300/300 (V0001, seed 11) and 300/300 (V0002, seed 12). No arithmetic or ordering structure was found in the table (rows are not permutations, e.g. first=ku gives vi for three different last tokens), so it is reported as a lookup table.

H2 supported with detail (all local-full). Positions 2,3 carry nothing: resid patching effects |x| < 0.005 (E0009); positions 1 and 4 carry everything (0.40/0.57 at layer 0, 0.32/0.64 entering layer 1), so about a third of the effect still sits at position 1 after layer 0 and can only reach the output through layer-1 attention. All four heads attend from the last position mostly to position 1 (E0010: 1.1 0.71, 0.0 0.57, 1.0 0.47, 0.1 0.41). Mean ablation, fraction of clean logit diff: 1.0 0.52, 1.1 0.70, 0.0 0.77, 0.1 0.86 (E0011); mlp0 0.29, mlp1 0.24 (E0012); 0.0+0.1 jointly 0.63 (E0013); 1.0+1.1 jointly 0.26 (E0014). Circuit {0.0,1.0,1.1,mlp0,mlp1}: ablating it gives accuracy 0.157 (chance ~1/6), ablating only 0.1 keeps accuracy 0.967 and 85% of the logit diff (V0001, verified). Dropping 0.0 as well fails: accuracy 0.577 (V0002, not-verified). So 0.1 is a weak contributor to margin rather than strictly inert; no component has exactly zero effect. E0017 (H4, mlp1 writes the answer) was scored INCONCLUSIVE because I pre-registered a metric path that does not exist (mlp_out patching is all-positions, not per-position); the observed all-position effects were mlp1 0.78, mlp0 0.76, so the sub-claim 'mlp1 more than mlp0' is at best marginal. Not re-registered.
Supported: E0005 72/72, V0001 and V0002 agreement 300/300 each on held-out seeds.

Revised: positions and routes confirmed (E0009, E0010, E0011-E0014, V0001), but head 1.0 also attends mostly to position 1 on fresh data (E0010; in E0004 its top key was BOS), and head 0.1 is only a weak contributor (V0001: accuracy 0.967 with it ablated). The division of labour between mlp0 and mlp1 is not resolved (E0017 inconclusive).
